title_zh: 安排教会志愿者的简短致谢

scenario.label_zh: 安排教会志愿者的简短致谢
scenario.goal_zh: 选定感谢志愿者的具体工作，并尊重本人不愿上台讲话的意愿

context_zh: 教会活动负责人询问长期志愿者，希望在周末聚会表达感谢。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: The congregation would like to thank you for keeping the weekly meal service going.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: That's kind, but please don't ask me to give a speech.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: You have been a dedicated volunteer for years. Would a short thank-you from me be comfortable?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Yes, if you mention the whole kitchen team. They do much more than people see.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.text: I will. I'll thank the team for their dedication and mention the early starts and the washing-up, not just the cooking.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: That sounds lovely. A few words while I stay in my seat would be perfect.
